build_neb_frames_dissociation: build NEB initial and final frames for a dissociation reaction using AutoFrameDissociation
build_neb_frames_transfer: build NEB initial and final frames for a transfer reaction using AutoFrameTransfer
build_neb_frames_desorption: build NEB initial and final frames for a desorption reaction using AutoFrameDesorption
interpolate_and_correct_frames: interpolate between initial and final ASE atoms frames and correct for atomic overlap
unwrap_atoms_pbc: unwrap atoms across periodic boundary conditions to find the shortest path for interpolation
check_edge_list_respected: check if an ASE atoms object respects the expected adsorbate-adsorbate edge connectivity
check_adsorbate_adsorbed: check if an adsorbate is adsorbed on a surface slab using covalent radius thresholds
reorder_adsorbate_atoms: reorder adsorbate atoms in a frame to match the initial frame using an index mapping
remove_duplicate_systems: remove duplicate ASE atoms systems keeping only the lowest energy unique configurations
traverse_adsorbate_bonds: traverse adsorbate atoms via depth-first search on the bond graph to minimize distance along bonds
